vocabulary.meaning_en: the part of a store that sells clothes
vocabulary.example: The clothing section is on the first floor.

vocabulary.note_ar: first floor: في أمريكا الطابق الأرضي غالبًا
vocabulary.note_en: In the US, the first floor is usually the ground floor.
vocabulary.example: The shoes are on the second floor.
I'm looking for a white tee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a path between rows of shelves
vocabulary.example: The tees are in the middle aisle.
All our tees are on sale today.
What is the price of this tee?
Do you have this in green?

vocabulary.meaning_en: how big something is (small, medium, large)

vocabulary.example: Wool can shrink in hot water.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money you get back when you pay too much
a paper that shows what you paid

fine_lines.title: small, medium, large, extra-large
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مقاسات الملابس: small (صغير)، medium (متوسط)، large (كبير)، extra-large (كبير جدًا). تُكتب اختصارًا S, M, L, XL.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Clothes sizes: small, medium, large, extra-large (S, M, L, XL).

examples.sentence: Could I see the small size, please?
I need a large. The medium is too small.

fine_lines.title: price vs change
fine_lines.explanation_ar: price هو ثمن الشيء، و change هو الباقي الذي تأخذه عندما تدفع أكثر من الثمن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Price = how much it costs. Change = money you get back.

examples.sentence: I paid $50, so my change is $20.

expressions.phrase: Can I help you find something?
expressions.example: Hello, can I help you find something?

expressions.phrase: Where can I find the clothing section?
expressions.meaning_en: Ask where something is in a store.
expressions.example: Where can I find the shoe section?

expressions.meaning_en: Say what you want to buy.
expressions.example: Excuse me, I'm looking for a jacket.

expressions.phrase: Could you tell me the price of this tee?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني بسعر هذا القميص؟
expressions.example: Could you tell me the price of this bag?

expressions.phrase: Do you have this in green?
expressions.example: Do you have this in black?

expressions.phrase: I would like the one in white, please.
expressions.example: I would like the one in blue, please.

expressions.phrase: Could I see the small size, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني رؤية المقاس الصغير من فضلك؟
expressions.example: Could I see a larger size, please?

expressions.phrase: I will take one medium, please.
expressions.meaning_ar: سآخذ واحدًا مقاس متوسط من فضلك.

expressions.phrase: That will be $60. — Here you go.
expressions.example: That will be $15. Here you go.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask someone to wait a little.
expressions.example: Just one moment, please, for your receipt.

grammar.title: Polite requests: Could you...? / Could I...? / I would like...
grammar.explanation_ar: للطلب بأدب نستخدم: Could you tell me...? (هل يمكنك أن تخبرني) و Could I see...? (هل يمكنني أن أرى) و I would like... (أريد / أودّ).
grammar.explanation_en: Polite requests: Could you...? Could I...? I would like...
examples: Could you tell me the price of this tee?
Could I see the small size, please?
I would like the one in white, please.

grammar.title: Prepositions: on the first floor, in the middle aisle
grammar.explanation_ar: on مع الطوابق (on the first floor)، و in مع الممرات والأقسام (in the middle aisle).
examples: The clothing section is on the first floor.
All of our tees are in the middle aisle.
The shoes are on the second floor.

grammar.title: Do you have...? — Yes, we do. / Sorry, we only have...
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن توفّر شيء: Do you have this in green? والجواب: Yes, we do. أو I'm sorry, we only have...
grammar.explanation_en: Ask: Do you have...? Answer: Yes, we do / Sorry, we only have...
examples: Do you have any graphic tees? Yes, we do.
Do you have this tee in green?
I'm sorry, we only have four colors.

questions.question: Where can I find the clothing section? — It's ___ the first floor.
___ you tell me the price of this tee?
This tee is $30. — That's a very ___ price.
Not small and not large is ___.
The paper that shows what you paid is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A receipt shows what you paid.

questions.question: Do you have this tee in green? — I'm sorry, we ___ have four colors.
All of our tees are ___ sale today.
I would like the one ___ white, please.
That will be $60. — ___
questions.explanation_ar: Here you go = تفضّل (عند إعطاء شيء).
questions.explanation_en: "Here you go" when you give something.
